text:
Now, from sheer pain, I feel no pain;
my care has become my nature,
and I am so used to suffering
that joy frightens me more than torment.


Disdain is enough, and thought alone
to destroy a loving heart;
who waits to die of being scorned
finds his own feeling merciful.


Love dies and is reborn in a pair of eyes
more often than the sun sees its light,
now alive in gold, now tinged with shadow.


But, ah, Love, I excuse your anger:
if you give me death in order to live,
I ask, why must you give me life?

translation.title: Now, From Sheer Pain, I Feel No Pain
